Short pieces built from public microdata. Each one takes a dataset that is
already in circulation and uses it to explain one idea in statistics or
economics. The dataset is the occasion; the idea is the point.

These are descriptive and exploratory. They say what the data show and stop
there. Every number comes from a public source and is computed with the
survey's own design, the same standard the [Labor Market MX](data.qmd) pages
follow.

::: {#notes}
